title: 对话式视觉地点识别
summary: 提出将视觉地点识别从静态检索转向交互式对话推理的新范式。构建了首个大规模对话式地点识别基准DlgQuest-Cities，并设计了统一推理框架，包含跨模态检索器与智能提问器DQ-pilot。通过监督微调与强化学习训练，显著超越基线方法。
summary_en: Proposes a paradigm shift from static retrieval to interactive dialogue-driven reasoning for visual place recognition. Introduces DlgQuest-Cities, the first large-scale dialogue-based benchmark, and a unified framework with a cross-modal retriever and intelligent questioner DQ-pilot, trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, outperforming baselines.
